# Utsav Gupta Portfolio

Utsav Gupta is a full-stack software engineer based in Delhi, India, building SaaS products, web apps, mobile apps, AI study tools, and automations. He works mainly with TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native, and Expo, and his portfolio shows a strong focus on product engineering, technical SEO, and shipping practical tools that solve real user problems.

## About

- Portfolio site: https://www.utsavworks.in
- Positioning from the site: full-stack developer, app developer, indie hacker, and solo founder.
- Primary focus areas: web apps, mobile apps, AI workflows, automation, and SEO-driven product growth.
- Contact email: work.utsavg21@gmail.com

## Featured Projects

- Scribely
  - One-line description: AI study toolkit that turns YouTube lectures, PDFs, and other study material into handwritten notes, flashcards, quizzes, cheat sheets, and revision material.
  - Tech stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Neon DB, Prisma, GenAI
  - GitHub: Not linked in the codebase
  - Live: https://scribely.site

  - GitHub: Not linked in the codebase
  - Live: https://www.codemon.pro

## Professional Experience

- Software Development Intern, FoundersCart Pvt. Ltd. | June 2025 to August 2025
  - Built a CRM-telephony integration platform connecting IVR services with Kylas CRM APIs.
  - Built a Chrome Extension dialer for one-click calling from CRM lead profiles.
  - Implemented call-log synchronization pipelines that matched IVR records to CRM leads and created call activities automatically.
  - Integrated Sensibot conversational chat solutions inside Kylas CRM.
  - Shipped scalable integrations using REST APIs, event-driven processing, and real-time data synchronization.
